# Ramzi Bougdar

> AI Application Developer | PrestaShop & Shopify E-commerce Expert | Full Stack

A full stack developer, since 2026 I have been building applications with AI: agents, automation, content generation, document analysis, internal tools and AI integrated into e-commerce stores, with Claude.

I build on solid B2C and B2B e-commerce expertise with PrestaShop and Shopify: custom modules, integrations and connections to APIs, web services, data and logistics flows. Beyond code, I lead projects from end to end (analysis and estimation, technical and functional specifications, project management (delivery and client side), deployment) and I manage technical teams.

- Location: Antibes, Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, France
- Current position: Full Stack Developer at Datalinx (since February 2023)

  - Project analysis and estimation
